notes.title: v. 1.1 of Enraged released
notes.content:
[list]
[h3][*] Toned down the difficulty (especially in the beginning)

[*] Made combat-rolling more effective to dodging bullets (when timed correctly)

[*] Reduced off-screen shooting (elves with guns will still start shooting at you if your bullets hit them off-screen)

[*] Made the tutorial more clear that you need to punch/kick when grabbing enemies[/h3]

[/list]
